climate-change-feedback.alt: Two loops, each marked with a plus sign. Left, ice and albedo: Earth warms, snow and sea ice melt, darker water and land are exposed so albedo falls, more sunlight is absorbed, and Earth warms more. Right, thawing permafrost: Earth warms, permafrost thaws, microbes decompose the frozen remains, methane and carbon dioxide are released, and Earth warms more. Caption: a positive feedback loop makes the first change stronger; melting sea ice is part of the loop but does not raise sea level.
